jobs.name: lotion-head
jobs.prompt: Edit the supplied reference into ONE high-resolution isolated product component: the WHITE LOTION/TREATMENT PUMP ACTUATOR ONLY. Reference 1 is the exact source assembled product and is authoritative for shape: upright white cylindrical head, straight nearly vertical sides, a circular white recessed bezel with a larger DARK OPEN dispensing hole, stepped wider lower white sleeve; this is a lotion treatment pump, NOT a mist-spray nozzle. Reference 2 is the original isolated actuator shape. Reference 3 shows the dark lotion nozzle insert. Preserve the source front-on eye-level camera, exact head/sleeve proportions, centered round nozzle, flat level top, upright vertical axis. Improve to crisp photorealistic studio product photography: natural softly glossy white polypropylene, subtle curved reflections, clean edges. Output the complete white actuator and lower sleeve only, without bottle, metal collar, dip tube, overcap, label, shadow on floor, backdrop, detached parts or text. Entire component centered on a genuinely transparent RGBA canvas with 12% transparent padding on all sides. No white fringe, no debris. Match source object outline and proportions; do not use a tapered/conical head. Source nozzle bezel must remain visibly recessed and dark open at center.

jobs.name: roller-metal
jobs.prompt: Precise product-component edit of reference 1: regenerate this METAL ROLLER BALL WITH ITS COMPLETE WHITE PLASTIC PRESS-FIT INSERT PLUG as a sharp photorealistic studio cutout. Keep its exact upright front-on geometry, relative dimensions and symmetric silhouette. Reference 2 is the actual assembled product photo: use its frosted milky translucent polypropylene socket/housing appearance, but retain the complete lower plug shown in reference 1 for an exploded configurator. One polished stainless steel spherical ball fully and realistically seated within the upper socket; only the upper spherical cap projects above housing, perfectly round centered, no flat cut, dents or floating gap. Natural large studio softbox reflections on the steel, not chrome stripes drawn flat. Housing matte translucent white with plausible wall thickness, smooth molded surfaces, thin continuous seating flange, lower slightly tapered hollow press-fit plug stem and a level bottom, no glass bottle included. The ball must be part of the same insert assembly, not separated. Clean high fidelity edges, no broken pixels, no white halo/debris. Entire component centered with at least 12 percent transparent padding, output true transparent RGBA. No floor shadow, no lettering, no other pieces. Preserve the original reference's scale ratio: flange width to total height roughly 374:531, ball visible width about 248 out of 374 flange width, top dome rises only 96 out of total 531 height.

jobs.prompt: Make ONE localized material edit to this exact product-component cutout. Change ONLY the exposed polished steel roller sphere into smooth white translucent plastic (natural opaque milky white polypropylene ball with gentle studio highlights). Preserve pixel-identical scale, shape, frame, axis, housing, seating flange, lower tapered press-fit plug and camera angle. Also remove the detached white fringe/debris immediately outside the component silhouette, leaving a crisp smooth antialiased alpha boundary. Transparent background must remain transparent. No bottle, cap, text, extra parts, or floor shadow. No changes to plastic housing, no taller ball, no floating gap, no clipping. High resolution premium realistic product photography.

jobs.prompt: Recreate the isolated small LOTION PUMP INTERNAL MECHANISM AND DIP TUBE shown in the reference as high fidelity photorealistic translucent polymer on transparent background. Preserve the visible mechanism's original general shape: long compact cylindrical milky-white pump chamber at top, tapering lower connector, one thin slightly naturally curved semi-transparent flexible tube extending down. Correct the disproportionately thick existing tube: chamber diameter approx 5 mm, tube outside diameter only 1.4 mm, total assembly length approx 61 mm, chamber occupies about 22 mm, lower tube occupies remaining 39 mm. Center on vertical axis, very slight tube bend at lower quarter only, lower tip clean angled cut. No metal collar, actuator, bottle, overcap, spring sticking out or duplicate tube. Realistic molded seam and gently transmitted light, visible transparent wall edges, not a solid white rod. Eye-level straight-on camera, soft natural studio highlights, no clipping, no floor or contact shadow, genuine transparent background with at least 10% margin, crisp clean smooth antialiased edges without white fringe or debris. One complete continuous connected mechanism.
